note: On the southeast edge of Greeley near US-34/US-85 and UNC, in two lots split by the road (501 E 27th St / 810 E 28th St); in-town plains location. Predominantly a long-term RV community that also takes weekly and nightly stays. --Claude
summary: Operator site: 2026 $55/night for 1-6 nights ($50 for 7+, $775/month plus utilities), so fees 50-55 -> 55-55. Confirmed 179 sites, full hookups 30/50 amp, 60+ ft pull-through and back-in sites, laundry and a shower room; reservations by request form or phone. Cleared the directory-era 45-ft max (no operator figure) and Wi-Fi (not listed). Over the US$50 gate with no gateway within 40 km (Rocky Mountain NP 75 km, Denver 78 km); the family has not stayed here. Note trimmed of field facts and the stale ~$36 figure.
